Review Title: Do not trust these people!!! What a disappointment!!
Review Text: During my trip to Alaska, the most important thing to me was to take a tour on a float plane. I booked this the last day of our cruise, which was in Ketchikan Alaska. On our way into the port, I watched excitedly as one float plane after another left and flew in front of our balcony. I couldn't wait and told several friends and family members how excited I was to take this flight  that was scheduled for 4 PM. I got to the meeting place 15 minutes early when I received a phone call that the flight was canceled. When I inquired why it was canceled there was a pause and then the woman on the other end of the line told me there was a mechanical issue that they thought would be fixed in time for the flight, but they couldn't fix it. I found out shortly after from a person in the business that they called to try and help fill the plane that a mechanical wasn't the case at all. The plane wasn't full so they canceled it. On top of a HUGE disappointment. I was even more disappointed that they flat out lied to me. Had they been honest I might have even paid for the empty seats for this experience, but they never even gave me the chance. I called their number back and it went right to voicemail. I left 2 messages asking if perhaps they knew another pilot that could take me on a flight  but of course never heard back from them.  It's obvious  they care much more about how much money is in their pocket than they do about customer service or even honesty. I would never trust these people. They lost a lot more money by not even offering to let me pay for the empty seats and more importantly, lost respect, which is the one and only thing people in business have. What a total disappointment.
Disclaimer: This review is the subjective opinion of a Tripadvisor member and not of Tripadvisor LLC.

Review Text:
On 7/25/2023 we took the Misty Fjords flight seeing tour. There were a total of 8 passengers on a well maintained DHC-3.

The best I can say is that Taquan Air completely mailed it in. For the price it should have been significantly better. Buyer beware and spend your valuable money on other activities.

The total cost for all 8 was close to $3,000 for which we got a seaplane flight that fell well short of how it was hyped by the cruise line or on Taiwan Air’s site.

We expected that there would be narration by the pilot pointing out landmarks and notable features. The pilot didn’t utter a single word after boarding. Instead there was a cheesy pre-recorded narration that was spotty and difficult to understand. Passengers shouldn’t ask, “ are we at the Misty Fjords”.

The pilot, although clearly proficient, was going through the motions and was clearly disinterested in anything except for talking to his fellow pilots in the radio.

This was the only regrettable experience of the 2-week Alaskan experience. Don’t do it!!!

We took off and flew right past our cruise ship and then headed for Misty Fjords National Monument. Our pilot had a perfect balance of commentary and quiet, accompanied by a great playlist for our time aloft. The scenery was beautiful-rugged mountains, pristine lakes, lush forests, and waterfalls. We flew past an eagle soaring-amazing! We landed on a lake in the middle of the mountains, stood out on the pontoons for a bit, reboarded and then took-off again. Our flight was about an hour and we would have been happy to stay up longer! We look forward to returning to Ketchikan and doing this again and maybe staying in a cabin for a week or so!! Review Text: Our family took this excursion during our cruise stop to Ketchikan and on the recommendation of family.  Jim was our pilot, and was friendly with had eight (I believe) years of float plane experience, including prior experience in South Florida. The weather was gorgeous, and Jim took us up with upbeat tunes in our ears!  The scenery was stunning, with beautiful water and mountain views.  We literally flew over the mountain tops into the Misty Fjords National monument where we finally came down for a water landing (our first)... As the plane lowered towards the water, our pilot pointed out a brown bear and her cub at the water's edge, a wonderful thrill to see! Once safely landed, we got to exit the plane onto a dock where we could enjoy the stunning views and clean mountain air all around us. Review Text: We booked tour months ago for our first Alaskan  Cruise.  Had been told seaplane tour was incredible and not to be missed.  We arrived dockside at meeting place. Had to wait 15 minutes past scheduled pick up. Then when bus didn't arrive, operator liasion asked us to sit down it would be another 10 minutes. Then they asked us to walk to to different cruise terminal as the bus was still on way and it would be easier for driver to pick us up there. Someone asked about what if couldn't walk that far. Said could make the driver come, but would take longer.  We got to the next cruise ship and bus wasn't there yet. When it arrived, the bus unloaded some passengers. Driver was talkative but not about Ketchikan or Alaska. He said we were lucky because he had left passengers at station to come get us. Laughed about it and said they'd have to wait.  Arrived at station to find out that one plane was taken to the hangar due to mechanical issues. Asked for six volunteers.  After rearranging dinners for some passengers, we were told they would go on 5:30 flight.  Okay, then we were told by Tiger that he needed two more volunteers because if weight limitations.  We volunteered as other remaining passengers were celebrating or had second tours.  We were told we would go at 3:30. After group was called for boarding, Tiger said it was the 4:00 departure. Why he lied inexplainable. When I asked him why he lied, he said that was "tour" time.  He said he couldn't control the planes and he couldn't control the FAA safety regulations.  Said if we had booked directly, he would be able to do something, but since we booked with cruise line, he couldn't compensate us for the wasted day.   Still waiting for the tour. Will post if we ever make it to the seaplane.

Review Title: We had booked through TripAdvisor - then when we arrived we got an email with a time which was unworkable, then canceled
Review Text:
It is true that it appears to be much more economical to book Shore excursions through TripAdvisor rather than though the cruise line - our booking for 2 people was several $00's cheaper directly rather than through Oceania.

However the time they gave us was too close to ship departure time to be safe particularly when Oceania advanced their departure time by one hour.... When we tried to reschedule earlier - we were told there was no availability earlier - and they offered to refund our money (which was all done very timely = Honorable!!) Later we heard on the grapevine that there had been a crash, and a Taquan Air floteplane had crashed into a mountain in bad visibility. On shore, there appeared to be still multiple floteplane trips leaving, but we had left it too late to reschedule. Understood the circumstances, and greatly relieved there were no fatalities - but this was a huge disappointment in our own plans as we probably will not be able to do such a trip again in this lifetime ....

We were whisked from the port to the air facility in a comfortable passenger van and eventually joined there by passengers from several other cruise ships. Headsets allowed us to hear both the informative pilot and music which perfectly accented the stunning Misty Fjords scenery.  To say the least, it was both a breaktaking and awe-inspiring experience.  The highlight was landing softly in a quiet fjord and enjoying the landscape and wildlife that surrounded us until time to return to ship.  We highly recommend this trip!

Review Text:
I absolutely loved LOVED LOVED taking off from a lake, flying over snow covered mountains and landing in a tiny hidden lake in the wilderness! The views were spectacular!! SEE MY PIX. So there we were, silent... floating on a wilderness lake... then the pilot, Chuck says, "Anyone want to get out?" That memory will be seared in my mind forever!! What fun to literally step OUT of the plane and stand on a pontoon!! In the middle of the wilderness! Without any sounds whatsoever.
"Chuck" the pilot played GREAT music on the flight. We all had headphones on.
If you are going on a cruise and hesitant about a pontoon plane excursion... don't be!! Take off and landing was smooth as silk and goes down as probably the very top travel memory of all time! FIVE STAR! No, TEN STAR! (I've traveled all over Europe, done many cruises, river cruises, trains, etc. but doing this... was the best!!!)

Review Title: Amazing Taquan Air trip to Misty Fjords
Review Text: This was my favourite of all the excursions we did on our Alaskan cruise and we only booked it while on the ship because my friend liked the look of it. So very glad we did. The beauty of this place cannot be described - its vastness and silence, with nature laid out below and in beautiful action. The ice was just starting to melt in May so the waterfalls were still running, and we had a spectacular cloud-free sky. Glaciated valleys, forests and swamps - what an amazing landscape. I could have stayed in the plane for twice as long although the trip lasted over an hour in any case. At one point we landed in a fjord which was spectacular - I had never flown in a float plane before. The commentary was superb as well. All in all, what a superb way to feed your soul. Do not miss.

Review Text: Exciting adventure is what you seek? This is the one to book folks!  While on a cruise to Alaska in September, my husband and I chose the Taquan Air Misty Fjords Floatplane Tour.
